snippet.title: The Killing Stone - Final Release, October 21, 2026!
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781470/The_Killing_Stone/

The Killing Stone is a duel of diabolical wit and strategy - which invites you to Beat the Devil at his own game. Your mission: travel to the Arctic Circle in order to save a cursed family from the clutches of demons. Featuring the bewitching vocal talents of Emma Gregory (Baldur’s Gate 3) and Liam O'Brien (Critical Role), the entire story, including their voiced dialogue, can be played in authentic 17th-century English or a more contemporary style.
